name: TyreLifecycleManager
tagline: Axle diagrams, tread and pressure inspections, rotations, retreads and cost per km – the fleet tyre bay in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete tyre-management app for truck, bus, van and trailer fleets in one Power Apps code component: an axle diagram per vehicle with tread and pressure colours, fitting from stock with position, size, tyre-type, tread and age rules, rotations and dual swaps, single and whole-vehicle walk-round inspections, removals with reasons, the retread workflow of every casing with retread limits and casing-damage rules, scrapping with fleet-manager approval, legal / steer minimum, pressure, dual-mismatch, age and inspection-due checks, cost per km by brand and a replacement forecast from the wear rate.
features: Axle diagrams for vans, rigids, tractors and trailers
Fit from stock with position, size, type, tread and age rules
Rotate / swap with steer and axle-size checks
Walk-round inspection of all wheels in one form
Remove with reason and distance roll-up
Retread workflow with retread limit and casing-damage rules
Fleet-manager approval for scrapping usable casings
Legal / steer minimum, pressure, dual mismatch, age and inspection-due checks
Cost per km by brand, retreaded vs new
Replacement forecast now / 30 / 60 / 90 days and stock cover per size
Lifecycle board with drag and drop
Bulk retread, depot move, scrap and delete
Undo, back / forward, CSV export, tyre sheets
Power Fx outputs and OnSelect / OnChange / OnCreate / OnSave / OnAction / OnStatusChange events
Phone layout with bottom bar and compact axle diagram
